notes: This snapshot is a curated current-source index. It is not a claim that every Indian tax circular, case, GST notification, ICAI publication or state tax rule is embedded in the calculator.

incomeTax.title: Income-tax Act, 2025 applies for Tax Year 2026-27 onwards
incomeTax.detail: For tax payments for Tax Year 2026-27 and later, the Income-tax Act, 2025 applies. AY 2026-27 and earlier continue under the earlier framework, subject to transition rules.

incomeTax.title: Income-tax Rules, 2026 notified
incomeTax.detail: CBDT notified the Income-tax Rules, 2026 under section 533 of the Income-tax Act, 2025, effective 1 April 2026.

incomeTax.title: AY 2026-27 ITR forms notified
incomeTax.detail: CBDT notified ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4, ITR-5, ITR-6, ITR-V and ITR-U for AY 2026-27.

incomeTax.title: TDS transition rule
incomeTax.detail: For credit/payment events on or before 31 March 2026, the Income-tax Act, 1961 applies; events on or after 1 April 2026 are governed by the corresponding provisions of the Income-tax Act, 2025.

incomeTax.title: New TDS/TCS section references
incomeTax.detail: For transactions from 1 April 2026, TDS/TCS reporting uses the applicable table item under section 393/394 of the Income-tax Act, 2025 rather than old section numbers such as 194C or 194J.

incomeTax.title: New PAN/form transition
incomeTax.detail: Existing PAN/TAN numbers remain valid. New PAN applications from 1 April 2026 use the forms prescribed by the Income-tax Rules, 2026.

icai.title: Pre-Budget Memorandum 2027
icai.detail: ICAI Direct Taxes Committee invited suggestions on tax policy reform, simplification, litigation reduction and compliance for Union Budget 2027.

icai.title: Capital Gains Taxation and Exemptions webinar
icai.detail: ICAI Direct Taxes Committee listed a 27 August 2026 webinar on capital gains taxation and exemptions.

icai.title: Foreign income and non-resident taxation webinar
icai.detail: ICAI listed a 6 August 2026 session covering foreign income, disclosure and non-resident taxation.

icai.title: TDS compliance and ITR filing precautions
icai.detail: ICAI Direct Taxes Committee listed a webinar on TDS compliance and ITR filing precautions for AY 2026-27.

icai.title: AI in ITR filing
icai.detail: ICAI listed a webinar on use of AI in filing income-tax returns for AY 2026-27.

icai.title: Income-tax Act, 2025 and Rules, 2026 transition training
icai.detail: ICAI Direct Taxes Committee began training and publication work around the new Act, Rules and Forms effective 1 April 2026.

icai.title: ICAI bare Act and Rules publications
icai.detail: ICAI announced publications of the Income-tax Act, 2025 with section mapping and the Income-tax Rules, 2026 with rule/form mapping.
